verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is documented as running untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs, which implies hardware-virtualized isolation. Separate docs describe these as ephemeral execution environments, and Vercel Agent itself uses secure sandboxes to reproduce issues and validate code. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the isolation model (hypervisor/hardware-isolation specifics), sandbox lifecycle/API details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
